name: Runzivo sandbox, 16 vCPU, 64 GB
description: A Runzivo Firecracker microVM for this workspace: 16 vCPU, 64 GB, 8x equivalent minutes while running. Lifetime 8h by default (rzv orca defaults --lifetime 12h|24h); suspending stops the charge, deleting removes the VM and its files.
create: rzv="${RZV_BIN:-$(command -v rzv 2>/dev/null || true)}"; [ -n "$rzv" ] || rzv="$HOME/.local/bin/rzv"; [ -x "$rzv" ] || { echo "Runzivo: install the rzv CLI first: curl -fsSL https://runzivo.dev/downloads/rzv/install.sh | sh" >&2; exit 127; }; "$rzv" help orca >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Runzivo: this rzv has no orca commands. Update it: curl -fsSL https://runzivo.dev/downloads/rzv/install.sh | sh" >&2; exit 127; }; exec "$rzv" orca create --size 16vcpu-64gb
suspend: rzv="${RZV_BIN:-$(command -v rzv 2>/dev/null || true)}"; [ -n "$rzv" ] || rzv="$HOME/.local/bin/rzv"; [ -x "$rzv" ] || { echo "Runzivo: install the rzv CLI first: curl -fsSL https://runzivo.dev/downloads/rzv/install.sh | sh" >&2; exit 127; }; "$rzv" help orca >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Runzivo: this rzv has no orca commands. Update it: curl -fsSL https://runzivo.dev/downloads/rzv/install.sh | sh" >&2; exit 127; }; exec "$rzv" orca suspend
resume: rzv="${RZV_BIN:-$(command -v rzv 2>/dev/null || true)}"; [ -n "$rzv" ] || rzv="$HOME/.local/bin/rzv"; [ -x "$rzv" ] || { echo "Runzivo: install the rzv CLI first: curl -fsSL https://runzivo.dev/downloads/rzv/install.sh | sh" >&2; exit 127; }; "$rzv" help orca >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Runzivo: this rzv has no orca commands. Update it: curl -fsSL https://runzivo.dev/downloads/rzv/install.sh | sh" >&2; exit 127; }; exec "$rzv" orca resume
destroy: rzv="${RZV_BIN:-$(command -v rzv 2>/dev/null || true)}"; [ -n "$rzv" ] || rzv="$HOME/.local/bin/rzv"; [ -x "$rzv" ] || { echo "Runzivo: install the rzv CLI first: curl -fsSL https://runzivo.dev/downloads/rzv/install.sh | sh" >&2; exit 127; }; "$rzv" help orca >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Runzivo: this rzv has no orca commands. Update it: curl -fsSL https://runzivo.dev/downloads/rzv/install.sh | sh" >&2; exit 127; }; exec "$rzv" orca destroy
